Victoria Hutter provides additional information about NEA grants: in 2015, 65 percent of NEA direct grants went to small and medium-sized organizations. The NEA funds non-profits for specific projects or productions only, with proposals reviewed on the basis of artistic excellence and artistic merit by a panel of citizen experts.

Response to Forbes article regarding NEA funding disclosures for the Public Theater; clarification that NEA has been transparent about its funding of the Public Theater and Shakespeare in the Park festival

The Public Theater received $25,000 this year for the New York Voices program at Joe's Pub. Detailed funding history for NEA grantees for the past 19 years is available at https://apps.nea.gov/grantsearch/. Playbill has been contacted regarding the Public Theater's application process for the Shakespeare in the Park Season.
